label: sound
instruction_covers: speed from all positive deltas (advance and update) over sampling window
non-positive deltas update completed without rate evidence
finished_time/finished_speed frozen on completion via update
reset clears rate evidence, keeps total, allows fresh estimate
reason: Every hidden test scenario corresponds to an explicitly described behavior in the instruction; exact numeric expectations (e.g. speed==2.0, time_remaining==6) are directly computable from the stated rules, and fields like finished_speed, Task.speed, and Progress.reset pre-exist in rich.
